resolutions.finding: Shared Ethernet port capacity release must retry all waiting priorities
Equal native CAN and Ethernet generator IDs must preserve origin identity and latency
Ingress rejection or static misrouting must not shrink intended SOF terminal denominator
Settled Dijkstra neighbors must be skipped before checked cost addition
Accepted user controls beginning with @ must retain their identity
Unchanged conversion and sibling branch DTOs must not advance envelope times at retry or child SOF

verified_by_inspection: stage_conversion compares latest same-batch staged DTO before committed DTO; typed equality suppresses unchanged conversion and sibling branch records while retaining internal state staging
Conversion DTO mutations occur at observed, ready, or released milestones; late branch SOF leaves conversion envelope unchanged
conversion_upserts_preserve_milestone_times_on_retries_and_late_sof covers blocked retry, sibling suppression, delayed release and delayed SOF
same_batch_branch_sof_emits_each_changed_branch_once covers sequential same-batch updates and duplicate notification idempotence
ConversionRecord and BranchRecord add equality derives without serialized field changes
Ethernet shared-port retry selects all priorities by source; intended targets depend on VID and destination membership, with gateway exclusion at segment creation
Dijkstra skips settled neighbors before checked addition
Synthetic control marker is serde skipped; user control ID preserved and synthetic collision avoidance retained
Qualified native origin uses fixed media prefix, preserves full native ID and native schemas; output lookup selects matching medium
